Hi! Once again, let me introduce myself. My name is **Dicky Mulia Fiqri**, and I'm a **Fullstack Developer**. This means I'm capable of building complete applications—from backend systems and infrastructure to intuitive and responsive user interfaces.

## My Journey as a Backend Developer

I first started learning backend software development when I was in the second year of vocational high school.

My first programming language was **Python**. I still remember spending nearly two hours trying to solve an error that was ultimately caused by a missing colon (`:`) and the differences between Python 2 and Python 3. It was frustrating at the time, but it taught me one of the most valuable lessons in programming: patience and persistence.

As I became more comfortable with programming concepts, I started building automation tools. One of my early projects was an Instagram automation system that could automatically increase followers. I also enjoyed creating Telegram bots to simplify everyday tasks, such as saving personal notes, sending notifications, and monitoring error reports from other running applications.

## My Journey as a Frontend Developer

I was first introduced to frontend development in **2018**, but I didn't invest much time into mastering it because my projects at the time were heavily backend-oriented.

My serious frontend journey began in **2025** when I participated in the **Jagoan Banyuwangi** competition, where I was fortunate enough to become one of the winners. That experience motivated me to deepen my knowledge of modern web development and user experience.

When building web applications, I personally prefer **Nuxt (Vue)** over **Next.js (React)**. In my experience, Nuxt provides a cleaner project structure, a more intuitive developer experience, and better long-term maintainability. While both frameworks are excellent, Nuxt fits my workflow and development philosophy much better.
